findings.description: The instance user-data embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. These credentials are stored in Terraform configuration/state and exposed to instance users or anyone able to retrieve user data, enabling unauthorized AWS API access.
TCP port 22 is allowed from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing remote administration to arbitrary Internet hosts and enabling brute-force or exploit attempts.
The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or specify a KMS key. Unless account-level default EBS encryption is independently enforced, data on this attached disk is stored unencrypted at rest.
This snapshot is created from an EBS volume that is not configured for encryption, so the backup may contain the volume's data without encryption at rest.
The bucket receiving VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration. Flow-log records may therefore be stored without explicitly enforced encryption at rest.
